title: Engine decision: Godot 4 .NET
summary: Selects Godot 4 .NET over a parallel Rust + wgpu implementation, records supporting probes, and defines save-and-restart device-loss recovery and the connected editing milestone.
notes: Dominant content is an implementation-stack decision with evidence and an alternative rejected on cost grounds. The device-loss contract also supplies SPEC signals. Status is 'Final for the first implementation', not Accepted, so locked is false.
